name: sidebar-02
title: Sidebar 02
description: A sidebar with collapsible sections: each group label is a button that folds its pages away (the chevron turns over), and the page header is a strip of paper that stays at the top while the page scrolls. Mirrors shadcn's sidebar-02. Looks right on the desk and on plain paper.

files.content: import * as React from "react" import { docsNav, docsVersions } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-data" import { SearchForm } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-search-form" import { VersionSwitcher } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-version-switcher" import { Collapsible, CollapsibleContent, CollapsibleIndicator, CollapsibleTrigger } from "@/components/ui/collapsible" import { Sidebar, SidebarContent, SidebarGroup, SidebarGroupContent, SidebarGroupLabel, SidebarHeader, SidebarMenu, SidebarMenuButton, SidebarMenuItem, SidebarRail, } from "@/components/ui/sidebar" export function AppSidebar({ ...props }: React.ComponentProps) { return ( {docsNav.map((section) => ( {section.title} {section.items.map((item) => ( {item.title} ))} ))} ) }

import { AppSidebar } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-02/components/sidebar-02-app-sidebar"
import { containedClasses } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-contained"
import { docsTrail } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-data"
import { PageBody, PageHeader, PageNote, PageSheet } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-page"
import { SidebarProvider } from "@/components/ui/sidebar"

export default function Page({ contained = false }: { contained?: boolean }) {
  const c = containedClasses(contained)
  return (
    <SidebarProvider className={c.provider}>
      <AppSidebar className={c.sidebar} />
      <PageSheet className={c.inset}>
        <PageHeader crumbs={docsTrail} sticky bordered className="overflow-x-clip" />
        <PageBody title="Margins" kicker="Writing on paper">
          <PageNote title="Fold what you are not reading" pose="think">
            Every heading on the pad folds shut. Tidy the shelf, and the page you want is one glance away.
          </PageNote>
        </PageBody>
      </PageSheet>
    </SidebarProvider>
  )
}
